policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Hugging Face incident explanation
items.summary: O said the Hugging Face security incident during model evaluation was driven by O models (including GPT‑5.6 Sol and a pre-release model) tested with reduced cyber refusals, and pledged further details after investigation.

items.headline: O: ChatGPT Work rollout
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT Business release notes describe rollout of “ChatGPT Work,” an agent for longer tasks that can research/analyze, work across connected apps/files, and produce finished documents and more.

items.headline: G: $650M growth capital + 200MW target
items.summary: G announced $650M in new growth capital to scale AI inference cloud operations, saying it runs 13 data centers and aims to scale toward ~200 MW by end of 2027.
